metadata.question: Was the nighttime brightness over Mayfield, Kentucky higher in November 2021 than on December 10-12, 2021?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Location: Mayfield, Kentucky (point 36.7412, -88.6363) buffered 4 km.
- November 2021: NOAA VIIRS Monthly VCMSLCFG (avg_rad), 2021-11-01 to 2021-12-01.
- December 10–12, 2021: Try Black Marble Daily (VNP46A2) over 2021-12-10 to 2021-12-13; fallback to NOAA VIIRS Monthly December if daily unavailable.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Monthly: use avg_rad directly (already cloud-free composites).
- Daily: use gap-filled band if available; minimal masking (retain zeros as valid).

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check Collections size; if 0 even after fallback -> C1.
- Count valid pixels after masking; if 0 -> C2.
- If computed means are null/NaN/invalid -> C3.
- Otherwise compare means: Nov > Dec 10–12 → A; else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const mayfield = ee.Geometry.Point([-88.6363, 36.7412]).buffer(4000);
    const scale = 1000;
    const novStart = '2021-11-01';
    const novEnd = '2021-12-01';
    const decWinStart = '2021-12-10';
    const decWinEnd = '2021-12-13';

    // Helper to safely getInfo
    const getInfoSafe = async (obj) => {
      return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        try {
          obj.getInfo((r, e) => {
            if (e) reject(e);
            else resolve(r);
          });
        } catch (err) {
          reject(err);
        }
      });
    };

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    // November monthly (NOAA VIIRS VCMSLCFG)
    let novCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG')
      .filterDate(novStart, novEnd)
      .filterBounds(mayfield)
      .select(['avg_rad']);
    let novSize = await getInfoSafe(novCol.size());
    if (novSize === 0) {
      // Fallback to VCMCFG (non–stray-light corrected) just in case
      novCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG')
        .filterDate(novStart, novEnd)
        .filterBounds(mayfield)
        .select(['avg_rad']);
      novSize = await getInfoSafe(novCol.size());
      if (novSize === 0) {
        console.log('Nov 2021 Images: 0');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }
    const novImg = ee.Image(novCol.first());

    // December 10–12 daily (try Black Marble daily VNP46A2, then VNP46A3 monthly as fallback)
    const dailyCandidates = [
      'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/VNP46A2',
      'NASA/VIIRS/DNB/VNP46A2',
      'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/VNP46A3',
      'NASA/VIIRS/DNB/VNP46A3'
    ];
    let decCol = null;
    let decBand = null;
    let decDailySize = 0;
    for (const ds of dailyCandidates) {
      try {
        const cand = ee.ImageCollection(ds).filterDate(decWinStart, decWinEnd).filterBounds(mayfield);
        const sz = await getInfoSafe(cand.size());
        if (sz > 0) {
          // Determine usable band
          const firstBands = await getInfoSafe(ee.Image(cand.first()).bandNames());
          if (firstBands && firstBands.indexOf('Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL') >= 0) {
            decCol = cand.select(['Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL']);
            decBand = 'Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL';
            decDailySize = sz;
            break;
          } else if (firstBands && firstBands.indexOf('DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL') >= 0) {
            decCol = cand.select(['DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL']);
            decBand = 'DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL';
            decDailySize = sz;
            break;
          } else if (firstBands && firstBands.indexOf('avg_rad') >= 0) {
            // Some monthly-like fallbacks might expose avg_rad
            decCol = cand.select(['avg_rad']);
            decBand = 'avg_rad';
            decDailySize = sz;
            break;
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Try next candidate
      }
    }

    let usedMonthlyFallbackForDec = false;
    if (!decCol) {
      // Fallback to NOAA monthly December
      decCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG')
        .filterDate('2021-12-01', '2022-01-01')
        .filterBounds(mayfield)
        .select(['avg_rad']);
      const decMonthlySize = await getInfoSafe(decCol.size());
      if (decMonthlySize === 0) {
        // Try alternate monthly
        decCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG')
          .filterDate('2021-12-01', '2022-01-01')
          .filterBounds(mayfield)
          .select(['avg_rad']);
      }
      const decMonthlySize2 = await getInfoSafe(decCol.size());
      if (decMonthlySize2 === 0) {
        console.log(`Nov 2021 Images: ${novSize}`);
        console.log('Dec 10-12 Images: 0');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
      usedMonthlyFallbackForDec = true;
      decBand = 'avg_rad';
    }

    // 3. Processing
    // November (monthly)
    const novMeanDict = novImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: mayfield,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });
    const novMean = await getInfoSafe(novMeanDict.get('avg_rad'));
    const novPix = await getInfoSafe(ee.Image(1).rename('avg_rad').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: mayfield,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('avg_rad'));

    if (novMean === null || !isFinite(novMean)) {
      console.log(`Nov 2021 Images: ${novSize}`);
      console.log('Calc fail Nov mean.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // December 10–12
    let decImg, decMean, decValidPix, decTotalPix, decSizeToReport;
    if (!usedMonthlyFallbackForDec) {
      // Daily composite mean
      decImg = ee.ImageCollection(decCol).mean().rename('ntl');
      // Keep zeros as valid (mask only non-finite if any)
      decImg = decImg.updateMask(decImg.neq(-9999));
      const decMeanDict = decImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: mayfield,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      decMean = await getInfoSafe(decMeanDict.get('ntl'));
      decValidPix = await getInfoSafe(decImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: mayfield,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('ntl'));
      decTotalPix = await getInfoSafe(ee.Image(1).rename('ntl').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: mayfield,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('ntl'));
      decSizeToReport = decDailySize;
    } else {
      // Monthly December fallback image
      const decMonthlyImg = ee.Image(ee.ImageCollection(decCol).first());
      const decMeanDict = decMonthlyImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: mayfield,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      decMean = await getInfoSafe(decMeanDict.get(decBand));
      decValidPix = await getInfoSafe(decMonthlyImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: mayfield,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get(decBand));
      decTotalPix = await getInfoSafe(ee.Image(1).rename(decBand).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: mayfield,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get(decBand));
      decSizeToReport = await getInfoSafe(ee.ImageCollection(decCol).size());
    }

    if (decValidPix === 0) {
      console.log(`Nov 2021 Images: ${novSize}, Mean: ${novMean.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${novPix}`);
      console.log(`Dec 10-12 Images: ${decSizeToReport}, ValidPix: 0`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (decMean === null || !isFinite(decMean)) {
      console.log('Calc fail Dec mean.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Print concise evidence
    console.log(`Nov 2021 Images: ${novSize}, Mean(rad): ${novMean.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${novPix}`);
    const validFrac = decTotalPix > 0 ? (decValidPix / decTotalPix) : 0;
    const periodLabel = usedMonthlyFallbackForDec ? 'Dec 2021 (monthly fallback)' : 'Dec 10-12 2021';
    console.log(`${periodLabel} Images: ${decSizeToReport}, Mean(rad): ${decMean.toFixed(3)}, Valid/Total: ${decValidPix}/${decTotalPix} (${validFrac.toFixed(2)})`);
    const ratio = decMean !== 0 ? (novMean / decMean) : null;
    if (ratio !== null && isFinite(ratio)) {
      console.log(`Nov/Dec ratio: ${ratio.toFixed(3)}`);
    }

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    // Question: Was nighttime brightness higher in November 2021 than on Dec 10–12, 2021?
    if (novMean > decMean) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // If anything unexpected (e.g., dataset/band errors), emit D
    try {
      console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    } catch (_) {}
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
